name: plex-cache-dev
description: What builds and checks the web app's CSS, scripts and pages (dev/web.js): postcss-preset-env rewrites the newer CSS the targets below lack as CSS they read, Autoprefixer adds the browser prefixes they need, cssnano, Terser and html-minifier-terser minify, Stylelint, ESLint and html-validate check the source (no prefixes written by hand, no feature a target lacks but the graceful ones: for the CSS, in what postcss-preset-env makes of it). The image build runs the build; the suite runs the checks.

graceful.css-focus-visible: Safari before 15.4 draws its own focus ring instead: each :focus-visible rule stands alone, so nothing goes with it (WebBuildTests)
graceful.css-has: the one :has() rule only nudges a name 4px off its ⓘ, and stands alone
graceful.css3-cursors: a phone has no pointer to show a cursor on
graceful.css-touch-action: desktop Safari has no touch to act on
graceful.html.global_attributes.autofocus: iOS before 15 leaves the sign-in field for a tap
graceful.html.global_attributes.autocapitalize: desktop Safari and Firefox have no on-screen keyboard to capitalize on
graceful.html.elements.img.loading: Safari before 15.4 loads the posters straight away instead of as they scroll in
